title: Top 5 stoppage-time goals that rewrote football history
body: A countdown of the most consequential late goals in football: Beckham's free kick to send England to the 2002 World Cup, Solskjaer's treble-winner for Manchester United in 1999, Sergio Ramos's 93rd-minute header in the 2014 Champions League final, Iniesta's strike at Stamford Bridge in 2009, and Aguero's title-winning kick for Manchester City in 2012.
